title: Fix Shared Page Load for Anonymous Access
description: Resolve shared ingredient-list page load failure caused by CurrentUserHeaderHandler requesting authentication state outside a Razor component scope.

tasks.title: Harden CurrentUserHeaderHandler for anonymous/non-component scopes
acceptance_criteria: Shared ingredient list page no longer fails to load for anonymous viewer/editor share links
CurrentUserHeaderHandler does not throw when auth state is unavailable outside Razor component DI scope
tasks.notes: Updated CurrentUserHeaderHandler to catch InvalidOperationException when auth state is unavailable outside Razor component scope, allowing anonymous shared-link requests to proceed without X-User-Id. Added regression test coverage in CurrentUserHeaderHandlerTests. Web build passes and manual browser validation confirms viewer/editor shared pages now load successfully.

dependencies: Existing shared-token API endpoints and shared page route
AppHost orchestration for manual browser validation
